title: Ad bidder: compiled targeting rules on the per-request hot path
name: Bidder rule cache

questions.prompt: Since the bidder moved to text targeting rules, p99 latency has gone past the exchange's 10 ms deadline at peak and we're losing auctions on timeouts. The CPU profile is dominated by compileRule and regex matching, and the bidder's rulesCompiled counter grows as fast as the request counter. Results are correct, just slow. Fix bidding/bidder.ts so the tests pass.
